ANZ CEO Warns of AI Risks and Job Cuts

ANZ CEO Nuno Matos has issued a warning regarding the potential risks of Artificial Intelligence (AI), including significant job cuts. Matos also stated that regulators must learn from past financial collapses, referencing the Bathla collapse. Additionally, he commented on immigration, asserting that 'we should decide who comes here.'
